title: AWS Step Functions to AWS Lambda
description: Create an API Gateway HTTP APIs endpoint that starts a Step Functions synchronous Express Workflow

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The Step Functions Express Workflow can be started using the AWS CLI or from another service (e.g. API Gateway) to run an express workflow and return the result.

The SAM template deploys a Step Functions Express workflow that invokes a Lambda function and returns the response. The SAM template contains the minimum IAM resources required to run the application with logging enabled.
